description: package/0 in mix.exs (description, licenses, links, maintainers, files: include priv/defk_runtime.h and anything the build needs, exclude tests/examples/bench), version policy and CHANGELOG, a README that works on Hex (relative links), and mix hex.build dry run checked into CI. Whether and when to publish is gated on the verdict (defk-sgw.5: library vs research result) and the package name; this ticket only makes the package publishable and records what's missing.

comments.text: From defk-djy.6: at the Hex release, change @url_base in lib/defk/errors.ex to https://hexdocs.pm/defk/#{Mix.Project.config()[:version]}/compile-errors.html# (compile error footers currently use the GitHub blob on main), and update the footer examples in docs/language.md and Defk.Errors moduledoc. Hex package files must not need docs/ (footer falls back to the URL when it is absent).
Moved from defk-djy to defk-sgw: it is gated on the verdict (defk-sgw.5), and as a djy child it made bw roll that blocker up to the whole docs epic, hiding defk-djy.17 from bw ready.

Picked up 2026-10-14 after defk-sgw.5 landed. Two inputs only the maintainer can give before the package can build: the license (no LICENSE file exists; mix hex.build refuses without :licenses) and the package name (the ticket says it is gated with the verdict). The rest is mechanical: package/0 with description, files (lib, priv/defk_runtime.h, mix.exs, README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG), links; a CHANGELOG with a version policy; README links as absolute URLs for hex.pm; mix hex.build as a CI step; the errors @url_base switch at release time (defk-djy.6 note). Waiting for the two answers.
